snippet.title: Tears of Metal - Release Date Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/1913120
Discord: https://discord.gg/papercult

Tears of Metal is a medieval hack-and-slash co-op roguelike. Carve through hordes of enemies to reclaim your island with the help of your formidable Scottish battalion. As you tread your bloody path, uncover more about the mysterious Dragon Meteor and the treacherous enemy invasion. Coming July 22.
